page.layout: Two medallion portraits at the top, side by side, each with an engraved legend around the rim: left "OCHOZIA" with "ISRAEL", right "IORAM" with "R. ISRAEL". Below them one column of running text in two paragraphs. No notes in the margins, no footnotes.

main_text.p: OCHOSIA filius Achab, regnare coepit super Israëlem in Samaria anno mundi 3049. ante Christum natum 913. Hic impius, pravus,& utrique parenti perfimilis extitit:atque æger ex lapsu, misit consultum Deum Accaron, an conualesceret: reverterentur nuntii,dicentes occurrisse sibi hominem pilosum, renibus accintum zona pellicea, qui dixerit ut reverterentur, renuntiarentque minimè conualituram. Ochosias Eliam esse qui nuntios impediuisset ratus, misit ad eum Tribunum cum quinquaginta militibus,ut eum adducerent,quos omnes ignis coelitus demissus, consumpsit: cùm totidem iterum misisset Ochosias,eodè fato correpti sunt: Tribunus autem qui tertius missus est,supplex Eliam deprecatus est: qui Elias, ab Angelo præmonitus, cum hoc Tribuno ad Ochosiam perrexit. Tandem ab Elia increpatus est Ochosias, apud quem idipsum locutus est,quod per nuntios primùm prædixerat. Itaque ex hac infirmitate obiit, nullis relictis liberis: quare successit ei frater suus Joram. Vide 3.Reg.22.cap.& 4 Reg.1.cap. item Josephus lib. Antiq.9. cap.2. regnauit annos duos. Fuit alter Ochosias filius Jorā Rex Juda,cuius infra meminero:hic verò Rex fuit Israël.

JORAM frater Ochosiæ, & filius Achab, successit prædicto Ochosiæ fratri suo in regno Israël, regnauitque in Samaria duodecim annis. Huius temporibus Rex Syriæ Ben-adab obsedit Samariam, ubi fames magna invaluit, adeò ut venunda-retur caput asini octoginta[?] argenteis. Vide 3. lib. Reg. cap.20. Item Josephus lib. Antiq 9. cap.4. huic successit Jehu. Fuit quo-que alter Joram filius Josaphat, de quo supra, Rex Juda: hic autem Rex Israël.

page.notes: Medallion legends are engraved in the images: left "OCHOZIA" and "ISRAEL"; right "IORAM" and "R. ISRAEL". They are not part of the running text. "JORAM" in the second paragraph is set in capitals as a paragraph opener, not a heading. Spelling "Israëlem" kept with diaeresis as printed. The printed "3 0 4 9." is set with spaces between digits and is given here as 3049. The word "octoginta" is printed with an ornamental initial and is uncertain; the [?] marks it. Printed "pɔtoginta" appears damaged; the reading octoginta is inferred. Printed "Jorā" carries a macron as printed.
